founder_frame.name: Timeless From the Gate
founder_frame.directive: Build every future capability inside a durable frame that protects customer value, fair-market economics, rights, trust, reliability, ownership, auditability and long-term RMS catalog/IP value before scale.
decision_order: measured conversion, retention, repeat and referral evidence
automation and scale only after evidence

financial_growth_model.primary_goal: maximize long-term risk-adjusted return on RMS-owned infrastructure, catalog, brand, audience and production capability while delivering measurable customer outcomes
financial_growth_model.optimization_rule: Optimize contribution margin and customer satisfaction/retention together. Never optimize revenue by degrading fulfillment, trust or creator outcomes.
financial_growth_model.fair_market_rule: Use verified comparable-market evidence to establish floor, target band and ceiling. RMS-owned offers are subject to the same test as external-facing offers. Price changes require evidence, documented scope changes, cost changes or sustained demand/conversion signals.

customer_success_model.service_recovery_rule: Technical or fulfillment defects route to CARE/FORGE before additional monetization. Customer remediation is treated as retention protection, not an optional courtesy.

future_proofing.architecture: modular event-driven components with provider separation and normalized metadata contracts
future_proofing.automation: human-governed for irreversible actions; fail-closed on missing credentials, consent, rights, payment or destination health
future_proofing.data: collect minimum necessary metadata; keep private creator content outside normalized intelligence unless explicitly authorized
future_proofing.portability: do not embed business-critical logic exclusively in Discord, OBS, Restream, Stripe, Meta, Pinterest or any single provider
future_proofing.measurement: every revenue or growth feature must emit auditable stage events so interest cannot be confused with revenue
future_proofing.expansion_gate: new rooms, offers, external groups, platforms or automations require verified owner, purpose, moderation/fulfillment capacity, success metric and rollback path

purpose: Turn the verified Reset Discord studio channel into a controlled remote production entry point for a dedicated OBS scene and Community DAW workflow while building a customer-first, fair-market, measurable revenue engine that compounds RMS ecosystem and IP value.

discord.webhook_rule: Create only for approved outbound studio automation. Never expose webhook URLs in browser code or public config.

obs.future_scene: Reset Inner Circle Community DAW - Virtual Studio

restream.rule: Do not reconnect or broadcast automatically. Re-authentication is an owner action and must occur only during a supervised production test.

community_daw.project_name: Reset Inner Circle Community DAW - Discord.xpj

target_signal_flow: Optional supervised live broadcast through approved Restream destinations
Normalized session/fulfillment/revenue stage metadata to AOS after ingress certification

worker_assignment.ROWAN: orchestration, Founder Frame enforcement, dependency order, safety/economic gates, cross-system audit and Founder escalation
worker_assignment.FORGE: OBS scene engineering, source validation, audio/recording reliability, rollback profile, fulfillment reliability and technical defect reduction
worker_assignment.SIGNAL: approved live-event packaging, promotion routing, audience/discovery activation and qualified demand generation
worker_assignment.CARE: participant onboarding, consent clarity, guest experience, service recovery, satisfaction measurement and repeat/referral protection
worker_assignment.PULSE: fair-market pricing, unit economics, payment/revenue attribution, profitability scorecards and margin optimization; never count interest as revenue
worker_assignment.ATLAS: education/workshop use cases, creator training documentation and reusable curriculum/IP packaging
worker_assignment.LEDGER: rights/provenance guard for recorded music, stems, performances, third-party material, splits, licenses and approved repurposing
worker_assignment.CAPITAL: identify non-dilutive funding, sponsorship or grant opportunities that improve studio capability without forcing customer overpricing
worker_assignment.STAGE: artist-facing session/release readiness when DAION, Auralyn or future RMS artist brands use the studio

execution_phases.name: Founder Frame gate
steps: Define customer outcome, target user and reason to exist
Verify rights/consent and provider boundaries
Define fair-market price band or explicit free/community value
Define fulfillment owner, support path, success metric and rollback
Do not proceed when any mandatory gate is unresolved

execution_phases.name: Inventory and backup
steps: Export/backup current OBS profile and Luxury INNER Circle scene collection
Record current Wave Link routing and monitoring state
Do not modify existing working broadcast scenes

execution_phases.name: Dedicated scene build
steps: Create Reset Inner Circle Community DAW - Virtual Studio scene
Add isolated host, guest, DAW and branding sources
Create technical hold / BRB fallback
Keep Restream disconnected during engineering

execution_phases.name: Audio isolation
steps: Separate Discord guest, host mic, DAW and monitor buses in Wave Link
Prevent monitor echo and Discord feedback
Verify OBS receives intended buses exactly once

execution_phases.name: Consent, scheduling and customer workflow
steps: Use Discord studio channel as the session entry point
Add approved session request / consent / preflight workflow
Define customer expectation, deliverables, timing, support and cancellation rules
Send normalized session-state metadata to AOS only after CreatorHub ingress certification

execution_phases.name: Local QA and fulfillment proof
steps: Run private two-person Discord test
Record locally without streaming
Verify lip sync, audio isolation, DAW capture, no feedback, fallback scene and file integrity
Verify delivery workflow and customer-facing handoff before charging

execution_phases.name: Fair-market offer certification
steps: Benchmark comparable remote studio, livestream, interview, workshop and production offers
Establish market floor, target band and ceiling
Calculate direct cost, labor, platform fees, support allowance and contribution margin
Define included deliverables and optional add-ons
Require customer-value justification and Founder approval before Stripe binding

execution_phases.name: Supervised broadcast certification
steps: Owner reconnects Restream if desired
Test one approved destination first
Verify destination health before multi-platform expansion
Never auto-start a broadcast

execution_phases.name: Measured launch and growth
steps: Launch a bounded beta with explicit capacity
Measure satisfaction, defects, completion, repeat/referral and contribution margin
Improve the offer before increasing volume
Expand external groups, rooms, platforms, sponsorships or paid promotion only when evidence supports it

revenue_lanes.community_support: voluntary support only; never represented as paid membership access unless platform policy and legal structure permit it
revenue_lanes.virtual_studio_services: paid remote production, recording, interview, livestream, listening-session and creator-session services with explicit scope and fulfillment
revenue_lanes.produced_events_workshops: paid produced events, workshops, creator labs and group experiences
revenue_lanes.sponsorship: brand-supported programming only when audience fit, disclosure, customer experience and rights are protected
revenue_lanes.education: reusable workshops, training modules and Academy-aligned curriculum where valuable
revenue_lanes.licensing_and_catalog: rights-clean session outcomes may enter RMS licensing/catalog workflows only through explicit agreements and LEDGER verification
revenue_lanes.creator_gear: RS Vault gear as an optional identity/community revenue lane, not a forced bundle
revenue_lanes.repurposed_media: clips, recaps, interviews and promotional assets only after explicit participant approval and rights clearance

investment_return_metrics: customer acquisition cost when paid promotion is eventually used
dependencies: CreatorHub communications/intelligence ingress certification before AOS session relay
healthy payment integrity before any new payment activation
fair-market pricing certification before paid studio offer activation
verified Discord permissions for studio channel
defined fulfillment and customer support workflow
Founder-approved Restream reconnection before any live broadcast
separate approved Stripe buckets before payment launch
